summary: Keep the source task as a fresh exact deferral. Direct SEC and FERC evidence resolves the exact Sidewalk Infrastructure Partners, LLC identity and one active infrastructure holding and development platform boundary. The July 2025 FERC filing contradicts the production record's sole-OTPP owner presentation and proves StepStone ATS as a direct ten-percent-or-greater voting holder after an OTPPB transfer while OTPPB remained upstream. June 2026 SEC schedules prove two additional direct Series C positions. The sources still do not provide the complete cutoff member set, exact stakes, classes, votes or control, and they omit passive or sub-ten-percent holders and anonymous Form D buyers. Do not infer a complete cap table or apply a partial replacement. Make no database or seed change.
resolvedFormerBlockers: The direct 2019 SEC filing verifies Sidewalk Infrastructure Partners, LLC as the Delaware issuer and supplies initial offering and first-sale evidence without constituting a cap table.
The July 2025 FERC filing identifies StepStone ATS Infrastructure Partners LP as a direct ten-percent-or-greater voting holder after an OTPPB transfer and StepStone Group Real Assets LP as manager.
The July 2025 FERC filing confirms OTPPB remained an ultimate upstream affiliate after transferring part of its indirect interest.
The June 2026 StepStone Private Infrastructure Fund schedule proves 4,115,226 direct Series C preferred units, the acquisition date, cost, fair value and STRUCTURE Sidewalk LLC vehicle note.
The June 2026 StepStone Private Markets schedule proves 2,572,016 direct Series C preferred units, the acquisition date, cost, fair value and SPRIM Sidewalk LLC vehicle note.
The direct evidence contradicts sole-OTPP ownership but does not permit a partial owner after-image.

identityResolution.jurisdiction: Delaware; operating headquarters in Brooklyn, New York
identityResolution.boundary: Count the consolidated SIP top company once. Treat operating affiliates, subsidiaries, projects, funds, joint ventures, former Cavnue and Resilia, Renew Home and Verrus as separate operating or investment relationships rather than duplicate SIP identities.

verifiedRelationships.alphabet: Alphabet Holdings LLC was reported as a material direct voting vehicle in the reviewed FERC chain, but exact cutoff stake, classes and later lifecycle remain unavailable.
verifiedRelationships.otpp: TI Platform Holdings, LLC/OTPPB transferred part of its indirect interest to StepStone ATS and remained an ultimate upstream affiliate; exact cutoff direct stake, classes and votes are unavailable.
verifiedRelationships.founders: SIP ManagementCo, LLC and Brian Barlow's disclosed voting control are historical material-owner evidence, not a complete certified cutoff holding.
verifiedRelationships.stepStoneAts: StepStone ATS became a direct ten-percent-or-greater voting holder and is managed by StepStone Group Real Assets LP; exact percentage, class and full vehicle chain are unavailable.
verifiedRelationships.stepStoneFunds: Two June 2026 direct Series C positions are proved through StepStone Private Infrastructure Fund and StepStone Private Markets schedules, but issuer percentages and complete direct holder allocation are not disclosed.

rejectedInferences: Do not preserve Ontario Teachers' as SIP's sole current owner.
Do not treat narrative founder, spinout or portfolio language as a certified complete current owner set.
Do not convert ten-percent-or-greater voting thresholds, unit counts, cost, fair value or non-control labels into exact issuer stakes.
Do not infer Alphabet, founder, employee, management or anonymous Form D buyer retention or exit from silence.
Do not allocate residual ownership or create a partial ownership after-image while passive and sub-ten-percent holders remain omitted.
Do not infer any transfer between 2026-07-01 and the 2026-09-05 cutoff without direct evidence.

Exact percentages, classes and votes for all holders, passive interests, purchase counterparties and later cutoff changes remain undisclosed.
transactionResolution.nonEquityBoundary: Operating investments made by SIP, portfolio-company activity, project financings, fair-value changes and fund holdings that do not identify a complete company-level cap table cannot be treated as new owner rows or lifecycle events.
